topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: When the delivery person rang the doorbell and handed me a package, my heart began to race. The handwriting on the box was unfamiliar, a loop of letters that didn’t match any note I’d ever received. I noticed the name on the label—it wasn’t mine, not even close. It belonged to someone else, a person I presumed used to live here. My fingers trembled slightly as I set the package down on the table. I wasn’t sure what to do. Should I open it to find out what’s inside, or would that be wrong? The safest thing seems to be to call the previous tenant, but the number written on a sticker attached to the box had been smudged and was now unreadable. I decided to check with the neighbors; maybe they know what to do.
